I have been playing this game on and off for 15 years. Single player mostly, but i had my share in multiplayer and exterminatus. But sadly the passage of time has not been kind to this game. At my last two playthroughs, i had some issues in terms of graphics, chiefly resolution and aspect ratio. For some reason my resolution was 0x0 and my aspect ratio was NaN:Nan. Weird but suprisingly it didnt affect gameplay. 

In terms of singleplayer the is still highly enjoyable albeit with some flaws. If you are playing this game after the sequel, you might find gameplay a bit primitive. Story is mediocre, an ork invasion leads way to another invasion, which is pretty common in 40k games. 

Multiplayer is still somewhat active which suprised me still considering %90 percent of fans migrated to the sequel.

To answer whether or not to buy the anniversary edition or master crafted version, to be fair I dont know. I havent bought the master crafted version, because i didnt find the need to buy the same game second time for some updated textures.

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine is a linear third-person shooter set in the universe of Warhammer 40k. With a nice variety of weapons and skills, many different enemy types, and wonderful level design, you can't go wrong with this game. One minor issue I saw was that as you go throughout the game you aquire better and more powerful weapons; but, the enemies also become more powerful with more health and stronger attacks. As you can see there is a slight problem. Nevertheless, I found this game very enjoyable and never dull.
